title: Closing remarks and the club meeting
summary: Allen thanks Laine, who says he enjoys the visit and the sociable club he belongs to.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: That's about all I wanted to ask about. We don't want to take up too much of your time.
Listen, why aren't you teaching a party anyway, don't you know? Well, I'm glad that you came, you know, that you visited me anyway, you understand? So as I could get talking to you.
Well, it was a pleasure for us. Yes, I won't doubt that. We always enjoy talking to you. Be sure and tell everybody I saw you. Yeah. I'll see you at the next meeting anyway.

Yeah, I'll be up there. Good Lord, say the same. I'll be at the next meeting. We have a nice crowd up there. Pretty nice, sociable people. A very nice club. I like it. I like it. Ever since I joined it, I more than appreciate it. Yeah. Well, I'm... Of course, at that time I joined it... I met Dr. Shushon a few times, you know, and of course, lawyer Kenner, you know. Good stuff.
